content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments-honest-side-side-4|COREMERCH guide to venezuelan]]-creators-accepting-crypto-payments-3|How a]]s-9|digital]] creators face significant barriers to building profitable online stores. This guide focuses on how to deploy a robust crypto-enabled store using Cloudflare Pages, ensuring sovereignty over your infrastructure. By leveraging COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, you can establish a fully operational digital storefront in just 48 hours, bypassing conventional payment processing limitations.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The Cloudflare Pages infrastructure provides a solid foundation for digital commerce, especially in markets where traditional payment systems are unreliable or absent. You gain full control over your store without depending on third-party platforms that can impose restrictions or fees. This infrastructure is built for resilience, ensuring that your digital products can be delivered and payments processed seamlessly, regardless of the external market conditions that often disrupt standard payment processing.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To begin your deployment, gather all necessary assets: digital products, branding materials, and content for your online store. You will also need a Cloudflare account to set up Pages and Workers, a Supabase account for order management, and a NOWPayments account for crypto processing. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, as it will guide you through deploying the Edge Commerce Stack effectively, ensuring you are ready to launch your store within the stipulated timeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept multiple cryptocurrencies, which will allow your customers to complete transactions effortlessly. Integrate this with Supabase for managing orders and product deliveries. Set up your Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic, ensuring that product delivery is automated and secure. This step is crucial as it ties together payment processing and product fulfillment, providing a smooth experience for your customers from checkout to delivery.
Establish complete ownership of your digital store infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, conduct thorough testing on the mainnet to ensure everything functions as expected. After testing, promote your store through social media and other channels to drive traffic. When your first transaction occurs, you will witness the power of your new infrastructure as payment is confirmed in real-time, and products are delivered instantly. This is where your hard work pays off, and your store begins to operate autonomously.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure in place, focus on scaling your offerings. Add more products to your store, optimizing your marketing strategies based on customer feedback. Utilize analytics from Supabase to track orders and customer engagement. As your store grows, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced features and support. This will keep your operations efficient and your customers satisfied, ensuring long-term success.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Deploy within 48 hours with no reliance on traditional payment platforms.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate crypto payments into my store?

Integrate crypto payments by setting up an account with NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Follow their integration guide to connect it with your Cloudflare Pages setup, ensuring smooth transaction processing.
What are the advantages of using Cloudflare Pages for my store?

Using Cloudflare Pages offers high performance, scalability, and security for your digital store. It ensures fast page loads and protects against DDoS attacks, providing a reliable shopping experience for your customers.
Is it possible to run my store on GitHub Pages?
Yes, you can run your store on GitHub Pages using Stack 01. However, for more advanced features and better performance, consider using Cloudflare Pages with the Edge Commerce Stack.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 is deployed faster and offers more comprehensive features for a robust e-commerce experience.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 02?
Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. This timeline includes end-to-end testing to ensure your store operates flawlessly upon handoff.
